n: διὰ (dia) 'through' occurs in traditional manuscripts (WH+TR+Byz) instead of ἰδίᾳ (idia) '[by His] own' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+Treg)
οὐκ ἀμελήσω (ouk amelēsō) 'not will neglect' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of μελλήσω (mellēsō) 'I will be ready' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
μου (mou) 'of Mine' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH)
ἅγιοι (hagioi) 'holy' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Treg+TR+Byz) instead of ἀπὸ (apo) 'from' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH)
ἀπωλείαις (apōleiais) 'destruction' occurs in a few manuscripts (TR) instead of ἀσελγείαις, (aselgeiais) 'sensuality,' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz+KJV)
σειροῖς (seirois) 'in a pit' occurs in a few manuscripts (Tyn+WH+Treg) instead of σειραῖς (seirais) 'in chains' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+TR+Byz)
κυρίῳ (kuriō) '[before the] Lord' occurs in traditional manuscripts (NA28+Tyn+WH+Treg+TR+Byz) instead of κυρίου (kuriou) '[from the] Lord' in older manuscripts (NA27)
γεγενημένα (gegenēmena) 'they were' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of γεγεννημένα (gegennēmena) 'they were born' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
κομιούμενοι (komioumenoi) 'will receive' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+Treg+TR+Byz) instead of ἀδικούμενοι (adikoumenoi) 'suffering' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH)
πλεονεξίαις (pleonexiais) 'in cravings' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR) instead of πλεονεξίας (pleonexias) 'in craving' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz)
εἰς αἰῶνα (eis aiōna) 'into age' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ὄντως (ontōs) 'truly' occurs in traditional manuscripts (NA28+Tyn+TR+Byz) instead of ὀλίγως (oligōs) 'scarcely' in older manuscripts (NA27+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' is only in older manuscripts (NA27)
ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR) instead of ὑμῶν (humōn) 'of you ' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz)
ἐν ἐμπαιγμονῇ (en empaigmonēa) 'with scoffing' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ὃν (hon) '[reason of] this' occurs in a few manuscripts (NA28) instead of ὧν (hōn) '[means of] those [waters]' in older manuscripts (NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+TR+Byz)
αὐτοῦ (autou) 'of him' occurs in a few manuscripts (Treg+TR+Byz) instead of αὐτῷ (autō) 'same' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+KJV)
ἡμᾶς (hēmas) 'us' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ὑμᾶς (humas) 'you' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἐν νυκτί, (en nukti) 'in [the] night' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
κατακαήσεται (katakaēsetai) 'will be burned up' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of εὑρεθήσεται. (heurethēsetai) 'will be exposed.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
οὖν (oun) 'therefore' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+Treg+TR+Byz) instead of οὕτως (houtōs) 'in this way' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH)
